conviction_note: The two numbers agree in sign, and neither is fitted to the other. impact_sum -1.0 nets a reaction-history negative (-2.0) against a small positive for the progress rate and a possible revision (+1.0). The scaled number is p_up 43 on an abs_move of 6.5, which gives -0.91. abs_move sits above the 5.0 proxy because the name trades 79% realised vol after an 85% theme run, and its true-date print reactions have a median of 4.4% with two 17% moves. The lean is mild, not confident: on true release dates this name fell after 10 of its last 12 prints, and the only two that rose came with new shareholder returns. Those returns (split, 増配, first interim dividend, 優待) are already used up this fiscal year, and the stock has run +26% in 20 days into the print. A return or revision surprise from a management that is visibly promotional is the live upside risk.

No IFIS or 四季報 number could be sourced, so the plan is the bar and sizes are capped small. kabutan's own commentary calls the plan 増額修正含み (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4394&b=n202609141013). Sized against Q3 cumulative ordinary profit at this company's 5-year average Q3 progress of 73.8% (about 152m yen, per https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4394&b=k202510030009). My estimate is about 158-160m yen.

findings.finding: On true release dates (all 15:30 or 15:00, read off TDnet via irbank), 4394 fell the next session after 10 of its last 12 prints, including clear beats: H1 FY25 ordinary 2.9x went -5.54%, Q1 FY26 +57% would have gone the same way had it not carried returns. The only two positive reactions were the two prints that ADDED shareholder returns: 2026-04-03, split plus 増配 plus first interim dividend, +8.39%; and 2026-07-03, 株主優待 introduced, +17.78% to stop-high. This FY's returns toolbox is now spent, Q3 prints have never carried a returns item, and the stock goes in at 36x plan EPS after +85% since 07-02 (+26% in 20 days, +12% in 5) on AI/SDV/autonomous-driving theme articles rather than company numbers.
findings.why_not_priced: The baseline's history uses estimated dates and records 10 of 11 moves as positive-magnitude noise around a +17.78 outlier. The true-date sell-the-print pattern is not in it, and no analyst covers the name. If the market were pricing a no-surprise Q3, the stock would not have added +7.1% and +7.5% on 09-30 and 10-01 on rising volume (50k, then 186k shares) straight into the release. That run-in reads as holders positioning for a third consecutive returns or revision surprise.
findings.independence: Price series from Yahoo (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/4394.T?range=3y&interval=1d) and release times from irbank and kabutan disclosure lists (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4394&nmode=3). The returns history comes from the company's own notices (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260703/140120260703587340.pdf, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260403/140120260402597580.pdf). All of these are one reading of one pattern.

findings.finding: H1 ordinary profit of 100m yen was 48.5% of the 206m yen FY plan, against a 5-year average of 43.7%, and the plan was held. It now implies H2 ordinary down 9.4% YoY. With Q3 FY25 standalone ordinary at 59m yen, a flat Q3 puts cumulative progress near 77-78%, against 68.0% last year and a 5-year average of 73.8%. That makes an upward FY revision, or at least an above-history progress rate, the likelier forecast outcome. The company's revision record cuts the other way: no FY revision since 2020-10-08, the plan held after a 17% H1 beat, and FY25 finished 3% under plan with no revision.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no clean precedent for a revision. The Q3 FY25 print, with progress below average and the plan held, went -0.36%. The H1 FY26 print, an above-plan beat with the plan held, was swamped by the 優待 announcement (+17.78%).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. kabutan's 2026-09-14 feature already calls the plan 増額修正含み, and the stock has re-rated far beyond any 10% profit upgrade. A modest revision on a 4.8bn yen theme stock at 36x is unlikely to carry it much further, which is why this is sized at +1.0 and not at the guidance scale.
findings.independence: Q2 補足説明資料: AI-related revenue roughly doubled in 18 months and CoBrain revenue is about 3x YoY, but consulting profit is 微減 because of AI investment and Q2 standalone ordinary grew only +5% (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260703/140120260703587361.pdf). Same issuer, different document; mixed.

outside_window.finding: First 株主優待 record date is 2026-11-30 (1,500 yen digital gift for 100+ shares, about 1.9% at spot). Holders have a reason to stay long into November, but the support does not resolve inside the window.
Management's plan puts a new company-wide AI service and executive-level proposals in H2, with 2027 as the expansion year. Any launch announcement is undated.

baseline_tension: My lean agrees with the baseline's run-up lean (-1.31), so it is partly the free control wearing another name. What it adds is the true-date reaction function: this name sells prints that carry no new returns item. Strongest positive the release could carry, and I did look for it: an upward FY revision (supported by the progress math) or another returns item (増配 under the stated 累進配当 policy, or a 優待 expansion). Either could repeat the +8 to +18 reactions, which is why p_up is only 43.
lessons_applied: Open question 4 (a five-day run-in sized as a short went wrong on 09-24, +8.15%) plus rule 2 (negative tilt): finding 1 shrunk from -2.5 to -2.0 and p_up moved from 40 to 43, because a returns or revision surprise from a promotional management is a live upside I checked for and could not rule out.
Rule 1 left finding 2 alone: it is a positive and rests on an expected ADD (a revision), not on a visible miss.
abs_move_pct left at 6.5; the lessons do not bear on scale.
